main_text.p: prodeat vero eo colore peregrino, quo facta omnibus conspectior fiat publica. Ita enim Tu voluisti, ut sic Lingua omnium communi Orbi traderem, in quâ utinam fœlicio-rem Tibi operam navare licuisset, ut illam Nativam Elegantiam, illam Vim verborum & Lumina, illam admirabilem sermonis struc-turam exprimerem. Quod cùm fieri (fortasse nec à peritissimis) à me certe non possit, præstat interim ut cum aliqua venustatis injuria magnam partem Europæ alloquatur, quàm intra paucos suæ Gentis clausa apud cæteros omnes conticescat. Sunt enim hîc velut quædam Dei Magnalia quæ spargi expedit humano generi, & in omnium linguis exaudiri: Id pro mea facultate curavi, ut si non sensa Tanti Authoris ornatè, at perspicuè & fidè traderem, imo nec

page.notes: The italic/roman distinction is approximate: capitalised words and some words in the middle of lines are set roman, the rest italic. Words I could not confirm letter by letter: "fœlicio-rem" and "struc-turam" (line-end hyphens as printed), and "prodeat", which may read "prodcat" in the scan. The last word "nec" stands alone at the right, as printed, and the sentence continues on the next page.
